readability.reads_as: dab: two quick, precise wrist taps (the second larger), syncopated
readability.note: 1/1 agree (dab, time +0.95, space +0.59). Taps at ~0.9 s and ~2.3 s, TCP peak 0.40 m/s, strip tip 1.09 m/s, extent 0.06 x 0.01 x 0.09 m (small as a dab should be). Accel peaks J4 60 % / J5 49 % in a sudden bar (under 80 %). The flagged J4 twitch (1) is the designed anticipation: J4 goes back ~0.9 deg at 1.83-2.08 s (the hold before the second tap) and then strikes; the accel curve shows no isolated spike.

awkward.evidence: twitches J4 = 1 (labels.flags); a ~0.9 deg wind-up before the second tap, anticipation by design (principles 1.0)

audience.note: Readable from AUDIENCE SIDE: the strip tips up and down by ~15 deg (ghost strips fan around 1.0-1.2 m), near eye height.

evidence: 3 big moves, A 2 O 1, onset cv 0.01, holds 2, dyn x4.02, still 32 %
timeline: two small taps (~0.9 s, ~2.3 s), each with a wind-up (A) and the second settling (O ~2.6 s), syncopated, holds between
joints 3, wrist share 84 %: the wrist alone, fine for a dab
expression.note: Two crisp taps with wind-ups, a settle and holds between: a lively dab; only the body stays out, which the dab hardly needs.
